purpose: Reconcile the authoritative 1944-04-30 weapons audit, branch production/development ledgers, current 1944-05-24 campaign state, and Yanagi technology gates. Separate hard authority from dated interpolation and unresolved factory-accounting holes.

grading.B: limited mission combat capable / incomplete integration

late_zui_sei_zero.note: No need to replace it immediately merely because A7M prototype exists.

kinsei_zero.basis: one additional partial month of allocation/acceptance; exact monthly engine/airframe factory ledger still open

raiden.5_24: A; national pool continues to grow slowly but exact May total is intentionally not re-counted without monthly acceptance ledger
raiden.guard: Do not convert national ready count into B-29-effective high-altitude interceptor count.

n1k2j.guard: Early operational growth only; no mass miracle.

a7m_reppu.branch_effect: The branch keeps the successor-fighter program technically healthier, but engine, prototype correction, carrier qualification, production tooling and pilot conversion remain hard gates.
a7m_reppu.ordinary_unit_gate: not summer 1944; late-1944 small operational possibility only unless separately re-audited
a7m_reppu.guard: First flight or good handling does not equal fleet issue.

navy_strike_recon.b6n: A; standard; B5N remains where role/availability justifies

p1y_ginga.note: first operational formations are expanding, not yet a theater-wide mass replacement

c6n_saiun.5_24_effect: high-value fleet/base recontact and long-range reconnaissance asset; exact count not closed

navy_strike_recon.zuiun: A-special reconnaissance/observation; 4/30 20-30 class retained as baseline

ki84.basis: late-May partial-month production/acceptance interpolation, with ready growth smaller than factory output
ki84.allocation_guard: Home defense, China and southern areas compete for new aircraft and trained crews.

ki67.5_24: production/conversion and service-evaluation ramp; ordinary combat credit remains 0
ki67.guard: Do not spend it in May combat.

tokai_mad.5_24: production/training continues; exact May national quantity not force-inflated without a monthly ledger
tokai_mad.current_operational_effect: 6-10 class local Tokai/MAD allocation around Sulu/Tawi-Tawi reaction area already permitted by current progression; main benefit is attack denial, reattack denial and faster datum handoff, not mass submarine kills.
tokai_mad.system: broad fixed-wing search -> datum -> MAD local confirmation -> air/surface attack -> shore handoff

i400_family.I401: commissioned April; final May joint-integration phase
i400_family.I402: commissioning Jul-Aug; integrated Seiran readiness Sep-Oct

effects: I-30-delivered Würzburg/Metox/Bold/TDC/metrology package has had ~1.5 years to diffuse into research, calibration and selected field nodes.
I-8 Dec-1943 return adds tacit fault-diagnosis/calibration/acoustic-test practice.
A-grade warning/plot/CAP-vector nodes are materially better than historical Japanese median.
The system is good at sector warning and loss avoidance; still not equivalent to US SG/PPI/CIC multi-target continuous control.
electronics_and_control.5_24_newness: Most May gain is doctrine, serviceability and network integration, not a magical new radar set.

5_24_centerline: captive-carry or underwing airborne hot-run/thrust/combustion measurement in Q2
design pruning from early I-34 Europe technical summaries
not_realized: self-propelled pure-jet first flight in Mar-May 1944
operational jet or rocket interceptor in 1944
physical Jumo 004B/HWK 509A in Japan by 24 May
next_physical_gates: I-34 return paper/small-hardware gate around June if the boat survives
I-29 Singapore information gate around July if the boat survives
late-1944 Ne20-like bench articles under favorable gates

carrier_construction.taiho: operational and five-carrier first-strike integrated by current campaign; repeat-cycle robustness still slightly below core four
carrier_construction.unryu: completion Jun-Jul; completion is not combat readiness
carrier_construction.amagi: completion Jun-Jul; completion is not combat readiness

surface.ibuki: remains heavy cruiser, not carrier conversion; late Jun/early Jul completion/work-up window
surface.fleet_destroyers: branch advantage is primarily survival and availability; no large pre-1944 construction miracle
surface.kaibokan_subchaser: modest procurement/availability increase; strategic effect is freeing fleet destroyers and protecting shipping, not adding battleline torpedo strength

chihe.5_24_issue: exact Mar-May monthly output remains one of the few unresolved production-book holes

75mm_turreted_stopgap.lineage: Chi-He-lineage turreted 75mm response to Allied medium tanks; historical Chi-Nu-like function but Branch designation/layout is not forced to equal historical paperwork
75mm_turreted_stopgap.prior_clock: first running/firing prototype band 1944-03-25..04-20, center 04-07; earliest low-rate late May, centered June
75mm_turreted_stopgap.5_24_adjudication: prototype existence and firing trials are REALIZED; debugging/tooling/acceptance trials ongoing; no regular combat unit yet
75mm_turreted_stopgap.guard: No mass output, no automatic Marianas shipment, and no quantity until 75mm gun/turret/engine/armor-plate wallet is closed.

ground_weapons.support_vehicle_priority: trucks, tractors, recovery vehicles, workshops and spares remain more important to 1944 operational power than rushing an unproven heavy medium tank.
